intro: Automating zoning compliance checks helps urban planners reduce the manual effort required to verify site plans against local development codes. By shifting from manual reviews to data-driven workflows, you can identify potential conflicts early and shorten the overall approval timeline.

blocks.text: The burden of manual regulatory review

Regulatory review is a critical bottleneck in urban planning. It involves complex, multi-departmental approval processes that frequently lead to significant time and cost overruns. You often spend hours cross-referencing site plans with dense, evolving zoning codes. This work is repetitive and high-stakes.
Why zoning compliance takes so long

Delays often stem from fragmented processes. Projects require sequential sign-offs from independent departments like planning, public works, and fire safety. A single comment from one department can restart the entire review cycle. Additionally, many planning departments are under-resourced. Only 1 in 10 departments in some regions are fully staffed, and 82% of authorities report difficulty hiring planners.

items: Use early engagement strategies to get feedback before formal submission.
Implement self-certification programs where possible for low-risk projects.
Adopt digital, data-driven platforms for design review to standardize the process.
Maintain a centralized, searchable database of local zoning ordinances on your Mac.

blocks.text: How to use Lazur for planning tasks

Lazur helps you manage the administrative weight of your work. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are reading a long PDF of zoning regulations, ask Lazur to summarize the key setbacks or parking requirements. Use the dictation feature to quickly draft responses to planning board comments or internal memos.

faq.question: Can Lazur automatically check my site plans for zoning compliance?
faq.answer: Lazur does not perform automated spatial analysis or verify site plans against GIS data. It helps you manage the documentation, summarize regulations, and draft reports related to your compliance work.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur for sensitive planning documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models.
